ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

divider.basic-note: Default horizontal divider with subtle appearance.
divider.custom-length-note: Set a fixed width for horizontal dividers.
divider.description: Visually separates groups of content, actions, or sections.
divider.dropdown-note: Divider works seamlessly inside dropdown menus.

examples.note: Start with the default divider, then explore appearances and variants below.

divider.inset-note: Control indentation from edges with start, end, or both.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

label.note: Label is only supported on horizontal dividers; vertical dividers ignore it.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

divider.spacing-note: Control margin around the divider with none, sm, md, and lg.
divider.strong-note: More visible border using the strong token.
divider.title: Divider

variant.note: Variant composes with appearance: appearance controls weight and color, variant controls only the line style.

divider.vertical-note: Use orientation="vertical" for vertical separation in toolbars and layouts.
divider.with-label-note: Add text between the divider lines with label or labelKey, aligned via textPosition.
